before: Delete or Backspace inside a control that showed its prompt removed prompt characters one at a time and kept w:showingPlcHdr, so part of the prompt stayed on the page as the placeholder.
after: A deleteText op that removes only part of a control's prompt leaves the part unchanged, so the prompt stays whole until the first keystroke replaces it. A deletion that covers the whole prompt, such as Select All, works as before.
reason: The kept deletion produces no tree change and no primitive, so there is nothing to replicate. Peers on a released version can still write partial prompt deletions, which this version applies as ordinary primitives. Stored fields, operation encoding, identities, and repair rules do not change.
